findings.reason: The sidecar defines this chip as conversations blocked on the operator (an approval to give or a question to answer); 'आपके लिए' says 'for you', which reads as a curated feed rather than a work queue and drops the 'needs you' semantics entirely.
findings.evidence: context sidecar note for the key ('blocked on the operator'); corpus vocabulary इंतज़ार is used for exactly this waiting relation (relay.ask.dismiss.moot_note, session.tray.approve_label)

findings.reason: A bare possessive noun phrase where the sibling statuses are predicates; without a verb or postposition it can read as 'your wait' rather than 'waiting for you'. The locative form is the idiomatic adverbial and stays inside the budget.

Hindi hyphens join coordinate pairs, so the compound can read as 'reasoning-and-effort'; it is also a third rendering of one English term where the corpus already ships रीज़निंग प्रयास (tui.notices.effort_default_changed) and प्रयास स्तर (tui.authoring.effort).
findings.evidence: tui.notices.effort_default_changed 'रीज़निंग प्रयास का डिफ़ॉल्ट'; wire.errors.desktop.effort_levels_missing 'रीज़निंग-प्रयास स्तर'; tui.authoring.effort 'प्रयास स्तर'; 'तर्क' for reasoning is attested in wire.settings.display_reasoning
findings.alternative: तर्क प्रयास (same length, keeps the native word) if the wave standardises on तर्क

findings.reason: Glossary consistency: the corpus's word for 'actions' is कार्रवाई/कार्रवाइयाँ (tui.transcript.group.actions, wire.errors.desktop.credential_operation_failed); क्रिया is only in this new key and also means 'verb'.

findings.current: संदेश भेजने या “जारी रखें” से यह आपके होम फ़ोल्डर में फिर खुलेगा
findings.proposed: संदेश भेजने पर या “जारी रखें” दबाने पर यह आपके होम फ़ोल्डर में फिर खुलेगा
findings.reason: The second coordinate has no verb, so 'से' attaches directly to a quoted button label; the idiomatic conditional is 'भेजने पर … दबाने पर'. Semantics (reopens in the home folder, exact Resume label) are already correct.

findings.proposed: सभी को पढ़ा हुआ चिह्नित करें
findings.reason: The definite object of a transitive imperative normally takes 'को'; the omitted marker is tolerated in telegraphic UI but is not what a native speaker would write.

findings.current: चिह्नित हो रहा है… / सहेज रहे हैं…
findings.proposed: चिह्नित कर रहे हैं… / सहेज रहे हैं…
findings.reason: Two busy labels on one screen use two voices (passive vs respectful active). Unifying on the passive is impossible because सहेजा जा रहा है… is 16 cells against row.saving's maxCells 12, so the active voice is the coherent direction.
The corpus's majority form is 'फिर से कोशिश' (relay.asks.sheet.retry, tui.notices.*); the clipped 'फिर कोशिश' is attested only with its imperative, so the status branch reads as a noun fragment.
